name: AI_Customer_Support_Voice_Agent_Workflow.
description: Production-grade backend orchestration for an external AI voice platform. Canonical request normalization and validation; protected order access is fail-closed and HMAC-bound to provider/session/call/tool/reference/timestamp/customer/order/intent. PostgreSQL idempotency is atomic, lease-aware and owner-fenced with stable canonical request fingerprinting, explicit key conflict/reuse detection, safe read-only stale reclaim and fenced stale side-effect reconciliation from durable provisional evidence. Side-effect evidence is a hard gate before DONE and uncertain side-effect outcomes never complete idempotency. Appointment availability is advisory and booking responses are authoritative. Side-effect POSTs use the canonical idempotency key without blind workflow retries. Persistence zero-row results and database errors are explicitly detected. Grounded AI responses are conservatively validated against verified knowledge. Operational logging is metadata-only and best-effort. Retryable transient persistence uses RETRYABLE_ERROR and is reclaimable by the same canonical idempotency key; side-effect completion remains evidence-gated and owner/fingerprint/intent fenced.

parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS idem_key,
    $2::text AS owner_token,
    $3::text AS request_fingerprint,
    $4::text AS intent,
    ($5::boolean) AS side_effecting,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF($6::text, '')::integer, 300), 30) AS lease_seconds
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO voice_agent_idempotency (
    idempotency_key, status, response_json, created_at, updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    idem_key,
    'IN_PROGRESS',
    jsonb_build_object(
      '_idempotencyVersion', 6,
      '_ownerToken', owner_token,
      '_requestFingerprint', request_fingerprint,
      '_intent', intent,
      '_sideEffecting', side_effecting,
      '_leaseSeconds', lease_seconds
    ),
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  FROM params
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING
    'new'::text AS claim_state,
    idempotency_key,
    status,
    response_json
),
locked AS (
  SELECT i.*
  FROM voice_agent_idempotency i
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE i.idempotency_key = p.idem_key
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
  FOR UPDATE
),
reclaimed_retryable AS (
  UPDATE voice_agent_idempotency i
  SET
    status = 'IN_PROGRESS',
    response_json = COALESCE(i.response_json, '{}'::jsonb) ||
      jsonb_build_object(
        '_idempotencyVersion', 6,
        '_ownerToken', p.owner_token,
        '_requestFingerprint', p.request_fingerprint,
        '_intent', p.intent,
        '_sideEffecting', p.side_effecting,
        '_leaseSeconds', p.lease_seconds,
        '_retryReclaimedAt', NOW()
      ),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM locked l
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE i.idempotency_key = l.idempotency_key
    AND l.status = 'RETRYABLE_ERROR'
    AND COALESCE(l.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint', '') = p.request_fingerprint
    AND COALESCE(l.response_json->>'_intent', '') = p.intent
    AND CASE
      WHEN l.response_json->>'_sideEffecting' IN ('true','false')
        THEN (l.response_json->>'_sideEffecting')::boolean
      ELSE p.side_effecting
    END = p.side_effecting
  RETURNING
    'reclaimed_retryable'::text AS claim_state,
    i.idempotency_key,
    i.status,
    i.response_json
),
reclaimed_side_effect AS (
  UPDATE voice_agent_idempotency i
  SET
    status = 'IN_PROGRESS',
    response_json = COALESCE(i.response_json, '{}'::jsonb) ||
      jsonb_build_object(
        '_idempotencyVersion', 6,
        '_ownerToken', p.owner_token,
        '_requestFingerprint', p.request_fingerprint,
        '_intent', p.intent,
        '_sideEffecting', TRUE,
        '_previousOwnerToken', l.response_json->>'_ownerToken',
        '_leaseSeconds', p.lease_seconds,
        '_reclaimedAt', NOW()
      ),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM locked l
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE i.idempotency_key = l.idempotency_key
    AND l.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND COALESCE(l.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint', '') = p.request_fingerprint
    AND COALESCE(l.response_json->>'_intent', '') = p.intent
    AND CASE
      WHEN l.response_json->>'_sideEffecting' IN ('true','false')
        THEN (l.response_json->>'_sideEffecting')::boolean
      ELSE p.side_effecting
    END = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(l.updated_at, l.created_at)
        < NOW() - (p.lease_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second')
  RETURNING
    'reclaimed_side_effect'::text AS claim_state,
    i.idempotency_key,
    i.status,
    i.response_json
),
reclaimed_readonly AS (
  UPDATE voice_agent_idempotency i
  SET
    status = 'IN_PROGRESS',
    response_json = jsonb_build_object(
      '_idempotencyVersion', 6,
      '_ownerToken', p.owner_token,
      '_requestFingerprint', p.request_fingerprint,
      '_intent', p.intent,
      '_sideEffecting', FALSE,
      '_leaseSeconds', p.lease_seconds
    ),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM locked l
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE i.idempotency_key = l.idempotency_key
    AND l.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND COALESCE(l.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint', '') = p.request_fingerprint
    AND COALESCE(l.response_json->>'_intent', '') = p.intent
    AND CASE
      WHEN l.response_json->>'_sideEffecting' IN ('true','false')
        THEN (l.response_json->>'_sideEffecting')::boolean
      ELSE COALESCE(p.side_effecting, false)
    END = FALSE
    AND COALESCE(l.updated_at, l.created_at)
        < NOW() - (p.lease_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second')
  RETURNING
    'reclaimed'::text AS claim_state,
    i.idempotency_key,
    i.status,
    i.response_json
)
SELECT * FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM reclaimed_retryable
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM reclaimed_side_effect
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM reclaimed_readonly
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(l.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint', '') <> p.request_fingerprint
      THEN 'key_reuse'::text
    WHEN COALESCE(l.response_json->>'_intent', '') <> p.intent
      THEN 'key_reuse'::text
    WHEN l.status = 'DONE'
      THEN 'done'::text
    WHEN l.status = 'RETRYABLE_ERROR'
      THEN 'retryable_error'::text
    WHEN l.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
         AND COALESCE(l.updated_at, l.created_at)
             < NOW() - (p.lease_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second')
      THEN 'stale'::text
    WHEN l.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
      THEN 'active'::text
    WHEN l.status = 'ERROR'
      THEN 'error'::text
    ELSE 'error'::text
  END AS claim_state,
  l.idempotency_key,
  l.status,
  l.response_json
FROM locked l
CROSS JOIN params p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reclaimed_retryable)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reclaimed_side_effect)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reclaimed_readonly);

parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS idem_key,
    $2::text AS owner_token,
    $3::text AS request_fingerprint,
    $4::text AS intent
),
locked AS (
  SELECT i.*
  FROM voice_agent_idempotency i
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE i.idempotency_key = p.idem_key
    AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND i.response_json->>'_ownerToken' = p.owner_token
    AND COALESCE(i.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint', '') = p.request_fingerprint
    AND COALESCE(i.response_json->>'_intent', '') = p.intent
    AND COALESCE((i.response_json->>'_sideEffecting')::boolean, FALSE) = TRUE
  FOR UPDATE
),
candidate AS (
  SELECT
    l.idempotency_key,
    l.response_json,
    p.request_fingerprint,
    p.intent,
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.response_json->'_provisionalResponse') = 'object'
      THEN l.response_json->'_provisionalResponse'
      ELSE NULL::jsonb
    END AS provisional_response
  FROM locked l
  CROSS JOIN params p
),
definitive AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM candidate
  WHERE provisional_response IS NOT NULL
    AND provisional_response->>'consistencyState' = 'confirmed'
    AND COALESCE(response_json->>'_provisionalOwnerToken', '') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(response_json->>'_provisionalRequestFingerprint', request_fingerprint) = request_fingerprint
    AND COALESCE(response_json->>'_provisionalIntent', intent) = intent
    AND COALESCE(response_json->>'_provisionalSideEffecting', 'true') = 'true'
),
completed AS (
  UPDATE voice_agent_idempotency i
  SET
    status = 'DONE',
    response_json = jsonb_build_object(
      '_idempotencyVersion', 6,
      '_requestFingerprint', d.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint',
      '_ownerToken', p.owner_token,
      '_intent', p.intent,
      '_sideEffecting', TRUE,
      '_persistenceMode', 'done',
      'response', d.provisional_response
    ),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM definitive d
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE i.idempotency_key = d.idempotency_key
    AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND i.response_json->>'_ownerToken' = p.owner_token
    AND i.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint' = p.request_fingerprint
    AND i.response_json->>'_intent' = p.intent
  RETURNING
    i.idempotency_key,
    i.response_json
)
SELECT
  p.idem_key AS idempotency_key,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM locked) THEN 'NOT_FOUND_OR_OWNER_CHANGED'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM completed) THEN 'RECONCILED'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate WHERE provisional_response IS NOT NULL) THEN 'UNCERTAIN_EVIDENCE'
    ELSE 'NO_EVIDENCE'
  END AS reconciliation_state,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT response_json FROM completed LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT provisional_response FROM candidate LIMIT 1),
    '{}'::jsonb
  ) AS evidence_response_json,
  p.request_fingerprint AS request_fingerprint
FROM params p;

parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE voice_agent_idempotency i
  SET
    response_json = COALESCE(i.response_json, '{}'::jsonb) ||
      jsonb_build_object(
        '_provisionalResponse', p->'response',
        '_provisionalRecordedAt', NOW(),
        '_provisionalOutcomeState', COALESCE(p->>'responseConsistencyState', 'unknown'),
        '_provisionalOwnerToken', p->>'ownerToken',
        '_provisionalRequestFingerprint', p->>'requestFingerprint',
        '_provisionalIntent', p->>'intent',
        '_provisionalSideEffecting', COALESCE((p->>'sideEffecting')::boolean, FALSE)
      )
  FROM payload p
  WHERE COALESCE((p->>'shouldRecord')::boolean, FALSE) = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(p->>'persistenceMode', 'done') <> 'retryable_error'
    AND i.idempotency_key = p->>'idempotencyKey'
    AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND i.response_json->>'_ownerToken' = p->>'ownerToken'
    AND i.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint' = p->>'requestFingerprint'
    AND i.response_json->>'_intent' = p->>'intent'
    AND COALESCE(i.response_json->>'_sideEffecting','false') = COALESCE(p->>'sideEffecting','false')
  RETURNING i.idempotency_key
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT TRUE FROM updated LIMIT 1), FALSE) AS evidence_recorded,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((p->>'shouldRecord')::boolean, FALSE) = FALSE THEN 'SKIPPED'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN 'RECORDED'
    ELSE 'OWNER_MISMATCH_OR_NOT_IN_PROGRESS'
  END AS evidence_state,
  COALESCE((p->>'sideEffecting')::boolean, FALSE) AS side_effecting,
  COALESCE(p->>'responseConsistencyState', 'unknown') AS response_consistency_state,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((p->>'shouldRecord')::boolean, FALSE) = FALSE THEN TRUE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
         AND COALESCE((p->>'sideEffecting')::boolean, FALSE) = FALSE THEN TRUE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
         AND p->>'responseConsistencyState' = 'confirmed' THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS side_effect_evidence_gate_pass
FROM payload p;

parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE voice_agent_idempotency i
  SET
    status = CASE
      WHEN p->>'persistenceMode' = 'retryable_error' THEN 'RETRYABLE_ERROR'
      ELSE 'DONE'
    END,
    response_json = jsonb_build_object(
      '_idempotencyVersion', 6,
      '_requestFingerprint', p->>'requestFingerprint',
      '_ownerToken', p->>'ownerToken',
      '_intent', p->>'intent',
      '_sideEffecting', COALESCE((p->>'sideEffecting')::boolean, FALSE),
      '_persistenceMode', COALESCE(p->>'persistenceMode', 'done'),
      'response', p->'response'
    ),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM payload p
  WHERE i.idempotency_key = p->>'idempotencyKey'
    AND COALESCE((p->>'shouldPersist')::boolean, FALSE) = TRUE
    AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND i.response_json->>'_ownerToken' = p->>'ownerToken'
    AND i.response_json->>'_requestFingerprint' = p->>'requestFingerprint'
    AND i.response_json->>'_intent' = p->>'intent'
    AND COALESCE(i.response_json->>'_sideEffecting','false') = COALESCE(p->>'sideEffecting','false')
    AND (
      COALESCE(p->>'persistenceMode', 'done') = 'retryable_error'
      OR (
        COALESCE((p->>'sideEffecting')::boolean, FALSE) = FALSE
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(p->>'responseConsistencyState', '') = 'confirmed'
        AND jsonb_typeof(i.response_json->'_provisionalResponse') = 'object'
        AND i.response_json->'_provisionalResponse' = p->'response'
      )
    )
  RETURNING i.idempotency_key
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((p->>'shouldPersist')::boolean, FALSE) = FALSE THEN TRUE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS persisted,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((p->>'shouldPersist')::boolean, FALSE) = FALSE THEN 'SKIPPED'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
      THEN CASE
        WHEN p->>'persistenceMode' = 'retryable_error' THEN 'RETRYABLE_ERROR'
        ELSE 'DONE'
      END
    ELSE 'OWNER_MISMATCH_OR_NOT_IN_PROGRESS'
  END AS persistence_state,
  p->'response' AS response
FROM payload p;

WITH payload AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO voice_agent_request_log (
    request_id, session_id, call_id, tool_call_id, provider, channel,
    intent, action, success, error_code, escalation_required,
    escalation_created, event_timestamp, message_length
  )
  SELECT
    p->'logRecord'->>'requestId',
    p->'logRecord'->>'sessionId',
    p->'logRecord'->>'callId',
    p->'logRecord'->>'toolCallId',
    p->'logRecord'->>'provider',
    p->'logRecord'->>'channel',
    p->'logRecord'->>'intent',
    p->'logRecord'->>'action',
    (p->'logRecord'->>'success')::boolean,
    NULLIF(p->'logRecord'->>'errorCode',''),
    (p->'logRecord'->>'escalationRequired')::boolean,
    (p->'logRecord'->>'escalationCreated')::boolean,
    (p->'logRecord'->>'timestamp')::timestamptz,
    COALESCE((p->'logRecord'->>'messageLength')::integer, 0)
  FROM payload p
  RETURNING request_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT request_id FROM inserted LIMIT 1) AS request_id,
  p->'response' AS response,
  (p->>'responseHttpStatus')::integer AS response_http_status
FROM payload p;

const ctx = $('Normalize & Validate Request').first().json;
const response = {
  schemaVersion: '1.0',
  success: false,
  requestId: ctx.requestId || null,
  sessionId: ctx.sessionId || null,
  callId: ctx.callId || null,
  toolCallId: ctx.toolCallId || null,
  provider: ctx.provider || 'unknown',
  intent: ctx.intent || 'unknown',
  action: 'request_fingerprint',
  message: 'I could not safely establish request identity. Please retry the request.',
  data: {},
  escalationRequired: false,
  escalationCreated: false,
  escalationId: null,
  ticketId: null,
  retryable: true,
  errorCode: 'REQUEST_FINGERPRINT_FAILURE',
  timestamp: ctx.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
  verificationState: ctx.intent === 'get_order_status' ? 'unverified' : 'not_required',
  idempotencyState: 'not_claimed',
  consistencyState: 'confirmed',
  upstreamStatusCode: null,
  httpStatus: 503
};
const logRecord = {
  requestId: response.requestId, sessionId: response.sessionId, callId: response.callId,
  toolCallId: response.toolCallId, provider: response.provider, channel: 'voice',
  intent: response.intent, action: response.action, success: response.success === true,
  errorCode: response.errorCode, escalationRequired: response.escalationRequired === true,
  escalationCreated: response.escalationCreated === true, timestamp: response.timestamp,
  messageLength: response.message.length, idempotencyState: response.idempotencyState,
  consistencyState: response.consistencyState
};
return [{json: {response, responseHttpStatus: 503, responseOverride: response, logRecord}}];
